name: Librum Sanctus (Book of Saints)
body:
School divination; Level cleric (only) 1, inquisitor 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a church warrant)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 minute

This spell, quite simply, mimics the Use Magic Device skill, giving the caster a +10 bonus to an attempt to use a scroll and treating them as though they possessed Use Magic Device as a class skill. A ‘1’ on the Use Magic Device attempt always results in a mishap (2d6 damage) and destroys the warrant.
